/**
 * @name Insecure HTTP requests
 * @description Making HTTP requests without SSL verification can lead to man-in-the-middle attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-http
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-319
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember(["urlopen", "Request"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("urllib2").getMember(["urlopen", "Request"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("http.client").getMember(["HTTPSConnection"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("httplib").getMember(["HTTPSConnection"]).getACall()
select call, "HTTP request without explicit SSL verification. Consider adding SSL context verification."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure HTTP requests without SSL verification

 */

import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

  call = API::builtin("hash").getACall()

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Shell command execution
 * @description Using shell command execution functions can lead to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/shell-command-execution
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "popen2", "popen3", "popen4"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("commands").getMember(["getoutput", "getstatusoutput"]).getACall()
select call, "Shell command execution. Ensure arguments are properly validated and sanitized."
findings.hypothesis: Shell command execution functions that could lead to command injection if used with untrusted input
